_readme.1: Per-environment settings for lib/infra-cdk-stack.ts, keyed by AWS region.
_readme.2: Add a temple by appending its table prefix to the right 'tableNames' list; each prefix becomes a DynamoDB table named <prefix>EventTable.
_readme.3: 'project' prefixes the audit-logs table and the Lambda/API names.
_readme.4: 'replicaRegion' is where DynamoDB Global Table replicas are created.
_readme.5: 'activeDbRegion' is which region the API Lambda reads/writes DynamoDB in.
_readme.6: 'createS3Bucket' (default true) manages S3 buckets; set false to skip S3 for projects that don't need it.
_readme.7: 'createAuditLogTable' (default true) creates the audit-logs table + route; set false to create only the tables in 'tableNames'.
_readme.8: 'replicate' turns DynamoDB Global Table replication on for that region.
_readme.9: Setting 'replicate' false REMOVES existing replicas on the next deploy.
_readme.10: Leave 'activeDbRegion' null for normal operation (the Lambda uses its own region); set it to the replicaRegion and redeploy to fail DynamoDB traffic over durably.
_readme.11: Deploying to a region not listed here is refused.
